claims.sourceText: American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 'Top Physicist: There Was A Nuclear Catastrophe On Mars (ft. Dr. John Brandenburg)', published 13 March 2025, at 1:34:53
claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 13 March 2025, at 1:34:53, John Brandenburg said that 'there was a contract between Los Alamos and Battelle Memorial Institute in 1949 and it was around nitinol', that the work was 'declassified by Battelle in the 60s', and asked why Los Alamos had a contract with Battelle in 1949. The board's node dates the corresponding nickel-titanium work to 1948-49 under Wright-Patterson sponsorship. The two accounts name different sponsors for the same alloy in the same period, and no contract record was opened for either.

title: American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 'Top Physicist: There Was A Nuclear Catastrophe On Mars (ft. Dr. John Brandenburg)' (audio)
